articles.headline: Mikal Bridges shakes off slump, hits buzzer-beater to save Knicks vs. Blazers
articles.description: Mired in a shooting slump, Mikal Bridges delivered a buzzer-beating 3-pointer to lift the Knicks past the Trail Blazers after they squandered a 26-point lead.

images.name: Mikal Bridges [600x400]
images.caption: Mikal Bridges, who is averaging career lows in points and field goal percentage this season, nailed the game-winning 3 at the buzzer for the Knicks on Saturday night.
